observations: The aerial has intact left and right horizontal arms and a visible central junction bump. The central upright and peaked/A-like roof support, including interior strokes, are present.

The central descending lead-like stroke crosses the roof/eave region, bends left and then down toward the upper-right area of the left window group. Its visible bends are preserved without inferring a hidden receiver or exact electrical terminal.

The left and middle window groups retain top edges, close horizontal crossbars, internal vertical divisions and separate open lower strokes. The far-right partial window/facade strokes remain partial, as in the independent full-page inventory.
The complete visible aerial/roof/facade drawing has white space around its extents. No question prose, 图127 caption or other neighboring text is inside this crop.
